quote: [CR2] answered the Isaiah 8:3-4 bound with 8:8 and 9:6-7, while [DR3] presses the sign's own bounds; the sign itself does not state the mechanism.
why: The verdict weighs the pressed Isaiah 8:3-4 bound against the answering verses 8:8 and 9:6-7 verse by verse and then rests on whether the sign itself states the mechanism, which is the stating-verse test the rule retires, instead of weighing the challenger's chain against the defender's chain by footing.
